title: Paul's Farewell Words to Timothy
description: In his final letter, Paul urges his young coworker Timothy to preach the word and complete his service, declaring that he himself has fought the good fight, finished the race, and kept the faith.

versions.title: Paul's Farewell Words to Timothy
versions.description: In his final letter, Paul urges his young coworker Timothy to hold fast to the faith and preaching, declaring that he himself has finished the race and kept the faith.
